name: Principles of Flight: How Aircraft Fly
summary: Explains lift, drag, thrust and weight, how wings and controls work, and how an airplane climbs, turns and lands.

topics.name: The four forces: lift, weight, thrust and drag
Airflow, pressure and Bernoulli's principle, and the common lift misconceptions
Airfoils: camber, angle of attack, lift curve and stall
Wing geometry: span, chord, aspect ratio, sweep and wing area
Drag types: skin friction, form, induced and wave drag
Aircraft anatomy: fuselage, wing, empennage, landing gear, engines
Control surfaces: ailerons, elevator, rudder, flaps, slats and spoilers
Axes of motion (roll, pitch, yaw) and the idea of stability
Straight and level flight, climb, glide, turns and load factor
Flight instruments and airspeed (indicated, true, ground speed)
Helicopters and drones: how rotors produce lift
Speed regimes: subsonic, transonic, supersonic and hypersonic flight
